summary: Comprehensive regression pass (iter162) after the large Organisation/People session. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (10 in test_deactivate_hard_delete.py from iter161 + 12 new in test_regression_iter162.py covering activity log, org-level list, admin-cannot-be-assigned-team, unassigned-list exclusions, deactivated-login-401). Frontend UI verified via Playwright with cookie-injected admin session: (a) People & Usage 'Deactivated' status-filter option present, (b) 'Deactivated' badge (people-inactive-badge-{id}) renders next to a deactivated user's name, (c) row menu correctly toggles Deactivate→Reactivate + shows Delete Permanently only when is_active=false — the OLD 'menu still says Deactivate' bug is confirmed gone, (d) clicking Reactivate restores is_active=true and clears the badge, (e) Organisation-level row (org-level-row) is pinned at top of Structure master list with live count (2), clicking shows org-level-panel with Test Admin + Demo Manager rows, (f) member-move-{admin_id} is correctly absent for admin rows, (g) Activity Log tab in /settings renders with 48 entries after test churn, showing 'Staff deactivated'/'Staff permanently deleted' with actor, target detail, and timestamp, (h) Edit User modal hides Team dropdown when role=admin (verified in source). Org left in clean 6-user state (all throwaway users hard-deleted, Diane reactivated). NOTE the 2 iter161 fixes (people-inactive-badge + hard-delete-confirm-guard against empty name) are both solid — badge verified live above; the empty-name guard exists in the JSX (`hardDeleteTarget.name.trim().length > 0` gating).
critical_code_review_comments: OrgStructure.js still ~1000+ lines and PeopleHub.js is 590+ lines — split threshold hit; consider extracting the hard-delete modal + MemberRow into their own files for testability and readability (carried over from iter160/161).

audit_logs.meeting_id nullability was correctly relaxed via m032 to support org-wide events (Deactivate / Hard Delete / invite-revoked) — good — but /admin/activity-log only surfaces meeting_id IS NULL rows. If a future dev adds a per-meeting audit action with the same 'action' vocabulary (e.g. Deactivate a shared reviewer FROM a meeting), it will silently vanish from this tab. Consider filtering by an explicit allow-list of action strings ('deactivate','hard_delete','invite_revoked') instead of `meeting_id IS NULL` alone so the tab stays semantically stable as more audit_log actions accumulate.

Dashboard-tile bounce-back bug is documented as unresolved. Not reproduced in this run (single click always navigated correctly to /organisation, /settings, and /meetings during 5+ nav operations) — either environmental or timing dependent; no additional signal to add.
